description: This file provides utility functions for currency conversions and formatting, specifically converting USD to credits, parsing USD values, and rendering formatted currency strings with credits. It centralizes the conversion rate and offers various formatting functions for display purposes.

methods.name: usdToCredits
methods.description: Converts a USD amount to credits based on the shared rate, rounding to the nearest whole credit.

methods.name: parseUsdToNumber
methods.description: Parses a USD-like string or number into a numeric value, handling currency symbols and commas.

methods.name: formatCredits
methods.description: Formats a numeric credits value with thousands separators and appends 'credits'.

methods.name: formatUSD
methods.description: Formats a number or string as USD currency using an external formatter, with fallback for invalid input.

methods.name: formatUsdWithCredits
methods.description: Formats USD with credits in parentheses, leveraging the external formatter with includeCredits support.

methods.name: renderUsdWithCredits
methods.description: Renders a span element showing USD and credits, with a tooltip, handling numeric and string inputs.

methods.name: renderCreditsWithUsd
methods.description: Alias for renderUsdWithCredits, backward-compatible, rendering USD first with credits.
